summary: Held through a strong run from entry to a +33.75pt peak around t=14-15m, since the trend was clean (rising highs, giveback near 0%, ER10 near 0.8). Bailed at t=17m once the pullback became a persistent, accelerating collapse -- four consecutive frames erasing 84% of the peak gain (down to +5.25), ER10 dropping to 0.23 (trend efficiency gone), and 5m volatility expanding rather than contracting. Next time I'd watch for the combination of ER10 falling below ~0.3 alongside 2+ consecutive frames of giveback >30% as the earlier trigger to bail sooner and preserve more of the gain, rather than waiting for near-full round-trip.
